title: Practice 2: до, после, около, мимо, кроме, вместо, против…

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Вдоль ___ (дорога) росли красивые маки.
exercises.prompt: Beautiful poppies were growing beside the road.
exercises.why: «вдоль» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Поставьте галочку напротив ___ (верный ответ).
exercises.why: «напротив» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: An old, rickety footbridge is the only way to get to the other side of the gorge.
exercises.ru: Старый шаткий мостик - единственный способ добраться до ___ ущелья.
exercises.why: «до» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I strongly believe in respawn after death.
exercises.ru: Я крепко верю в перерождение после ___.
exercises.why: «после» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: It'll take about an hour.
exercises.why: «около» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom slipped past the guard.
exercises.why: «мимо» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: He does nothing but read manga.
exercises.ru: Он ничем, кроме ___ манги, не занимается.
exercises.why: «кроме» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Many early cars used a tiller instead of a steering wheel.
exercises.ru: Во многих автомобилях поначалу использовалась рукоятка вместо ___ колеса.
exercises.why: «вместо» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: We need to work together, not against each other.
exercises.ru: Нам нужно работать сообща, а не друг против ___.
exercises.why: «против» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Among wild ducks, it seems there are homosexual necrophiliacs.
exercises.why: «среди» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The family members sat around the table.
exercises.why: «вокруг» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The impound lot was near the police station.
exercises.why: «возле» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The roads are impassable because of the heavy snow.
exercises.why: «из-за» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom got out from under the car.
exercises.why: «из-под» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The angry chimp went up the sidewalk and ripped everybody's face off.
exercises.ru: Злой шимпанзе шёл вдоль ___ и отрывал людям лица.
exercises.why: «вдоль» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The statue of Hachiko, the faithful dog, stands in front of Shibuya Station.
exercises.ru: Статуя Хатико, верного пса, стоит напротив ___ Сибуя.
exercises.why: «напротив» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я сплавал до ___ (другой конец) бассейна.
exercises.prompt: I swam to the other end of the pool and back.
exercises.why: «до» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я ужинаю после ___ (работа).
exercises.why: «после» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Они все толпились около ___ (звезда) экрана.
exercises.prompt: They all flocked around the movie star.
exercises.why: «около» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Мимо ___ (дом) как раз промчалась полицейская машина.
exercises.prompt: A police car just tore past the house.
exercises.why: «мимо» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
